profiles.name: Reading support
profiles.subtitle: Clear language, confident reading
profiles.description: Short explanations and vocabulary support, without losing the science.
requirements: Sections must be 90 words or fewer, with descriptive headings.
Include at least 3 glossary terms with plain-language definitions.
Use plain language and explain scientific vocabulary.

profiles.name: Attention support
profiles.subtitle: One manageable step at a time
profiles.description: A clear sequence, smaller tasks, and visible completion points.
requirements: Provide at least 3 sequential tasks, rendered as a numbered list.
Every task must have an explicit done-when completion point.
Keep every section to 120 words or fewer and each task instruction to 45 words or fewer.

profiles.name: Screen-reader support
profiles.subtitle: A lesson that reads in order
profiles.description: Semantic structure, meaningful descriptions, and a complete narration.
requirements: Semantic headings and a logical, linear reading order.
Describe the lesson diagram in at least 20 words, including relationships.
Include a complete narration script of at least 60 words covering the lesson.

rules.S1: Semantic headings and linear reading order
